name: D21 frozen-D2 enhanced-state contact residual
status: frozen before model construction or fitting
purpose: one bounded test of whether D20 contact information can be added without replacing or degrading D2 continuous dynamics
scope: D3+D12 TRAIN folds only; no new simulation, task labels, joint validation, DEV or TEST

model.base: frozen D2 StepGraphNet and frozen D2 integration scales
model.residual: 192-wide enhanced-state MLP with zero-initialized continuous and contact output layers
model.enhanced_future_heads: proprioception delta and force/impulse next state

stage2_if_stage1_passes.requirements: pose NRMSE no worse than D2 and pair-distance correlation at least 0.05 above D2 on both primary TRAIN axes

stage3_if_stage2_passes.requirements: separation-curve and frozen-v0 monitor agreement both improve over D2 on both primary TRAIN axes

stop_rule: any failed stage ends this model-tweaking line; no weight sweep, replication, DEV or TEST
